result.title: Action-outcome coupling: a pre-investment feasibility audit for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations
result.summary: Prescriptive analytics initiatives in logistics, such as offline reinforcement learning and next-best-action systems, are often funded before anyone verifies that the available historical logs can support an improved decision policy. We formalise this pre-investment feasibility question via action-outcome coupling: a total-effect variance index measuring how much expected outcomes change with the logged action. Coupling provides an algorithm-independent upper bound on any policy's achievable value, expressed in monetary units per decision for both single-step and discounted sequential objectives. We also analyse the asymptotic false-licensing risk of an invalid workflow: fitting a value model and evaluating the model's greedy policy on the same data. The false-licence rate is driven mainly by the number of state cells over which selection is performed, rising from the nominal test level with one cell to near certainty with a few dozen, while overlap has a smaller effect. We then propose an audit that assigns logs to four tiers of decision support, separately for fixed and contextual policies, and returns an explicit stopping rationale. On a randomised e-commerce log, the audit endorses a fixed recommendation policy, certifying gains equal to 30 per cent of the theoretical ceiling; the remaining gap reflects bound looseness under an 80-action design. Two public logistics logs fail at different checkpoints: one because the target is an accounting identity of the action, and another because, with 27 clusters, estimated coupling stays below the design's detectability threshold even though a conservative offline learner certifies an improvement in 29 of 30 seeds.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向供应链等场景的离线强化学习投资决策，提出以「动作—结果耦合」方差指数刻画日志中动作对结果的可影响程度，并据此给出策略价值上界、评估误放行风险分析与四档可行性审计流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先审计日志信息量再投入」的思路，以及在同一数据上拟合并评估贪婪策略导致选择偏差的分析，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 收益是否来自真实证据而非状态格上的选择、以及停止与继续投入的依据提供概念借鉴。
